THE PARLOUR / TAKE YOUR TIME

Merging Estates

Spatial building growth triggers company mergers that revalue contested stock portfolios.

Restart this deal
Another deal

A THOUGHTFUL LITTLE MATCH

Find your next move.

Place for growth or trigger merger when holding minority, buy rival company shares to anticipate payout, withhold a tile to change majority later, trade defunct shares into future leader versus realize cash.

Take a seat
How to play
6×6 lots, three companies, six secret lot tiles per player and refill bag. Turn place one tile, resolve adjacency: isolated remains independent; touching isolated cluster may found inactive company; touching one company expands; joining two or more active companies merges smaller into larger (placer breaks equal-size tie). Company size≥10 is safe and cannot be merged out; tile joining two safe companies illegal. Merger pays fixed majority/minority bonuses to stockholders; defunct shares may sell at old price, trade two-for-one into survivor, or hold for refounding. Then buy up to three public available shares; prices depend on displayed size bands. Cash finite; stock finite. End when every company safe or one reaches18 after current turn. If a player has no legal tile, reveal and discard only permanently illegal safe-merger tiles, refill if possible, then pass placement and retain purchase phase. Two consecutive no-placement turns with no remaining drawable legal tile, bag empty with both hands exhausted, or a full board immediately triggers normal final settlement. Remaining temporary unplayable lots may not be secretly redrawn. Settlement also occurs after48 full turns as a displayed maximum.
Liquidate all shares at current size prices and payout final bonuses; highest cash wins, equal draw. Cash exhaustion limits action but not premature defeat.
Controls & access
The important decisions

No timer. No account. A fresh approach is always welcome.

How to play

Turn place one tile, resolve adjacency: isolated remains independent; touching isolated cluster may found inactive company; touching one company expands; joining two or more active companies merges smaller into larger (placer breaks equal-size tie). Merger pays fixed majority/minority bonuses to stockholders; defunct shares may sell at old price, trade two-for-one into survivor, or hold for refounding. If a player has no legal tile, reveal and discard only permanently illegal safe-merger tiles, refill if possible, then pass placement and retain purchase phase. Two consecutive no-placement turns with no remaining drawable legal tile, bag empty with both hands exhausted, or a full board immediately triggers normal final settlement. Remaining temporary unplayable lots may not be secretly redrawn. Settlement also occurs after48 full turns as a displayed maximum.
